title: Weapon variants census, batches {start} to 9, one Map Maker map
summary: Records every weapon variant and fire mode that is not measured yet, one Map Maker weapon set per batch, in ONE game session (session folder tmp/owner-profiles/mm-var-all, the game is never restarted between batches). Each batch starts with an idle control, then one 20 s phase per weapon or fire mode. Plan and results: docs/t-weapon-variants.md (the phase labels here are the labels of its table).
duration: about 5 to 8 minutes per batch, up to 9 batches
prerequisites: Game HDD tmp/hdds/editor-hdd with your Map Maker level. The SAME level stays loaded for the whole session. The script builds the private host first (a few minutes).

A Map Maker map has only 6 weapon slots, so a batch is one weapon set of at most 6 weapons. Every x2 (dual) weapon, mine type, rifle, sniper and grenade type takes its own slot. A fire MODE (normal and bounce, rocket, alternative, spin, thermal) is switched on the SAME weapon and costs no slot, each mode is its own phase.
Batches below {start} are not shown and not asked. Starting at a later batch resumes the plan there, in the same session folder mm-var-all as the earlier runs.

Weapons that are NOT in the Map Maker weapon list (so far: Time Disruptor Grenade, Monkey Gun, TNT, Brick, Sci-Fi Rocket Launcher, and Uplink, Assault Rifle never found): leave them out and answer s at their phase.

steps.text: Press Enter in this terminal at 'Enter = start the game'. When the window opens drive to the Map Maker yourself: start, players, profile, Map Maker, load your map, open the editor, set the weapon set to the weapons of batch {start} (listed below, make sure each can be picked up in the preview), then enter the PREVIEW and wait until you can move. Nothing is measured until you continue at a prompt ({hotkey:advance}).

BETWEEN batches (no game restart): when the session asks for the idle control of the next batch, FIRST swap the weapon set to that batch (the weapon set page lives in the editor, so leave the preview, change the set there and enter the preview again, INFERRED), THEN continue ({hotkey:advance}) at the idle prompt.

How every phase prompt works: the prompt shows Switch to, Go to, Then, Time and Note. FIRST pick up the weapon (and switch the fire mode if the phase says so), THEN continue ({hotkey:advance}) and the window starts (the prompt says GO NOW). Use ONLY that weapon and mode during the window, stop with {hotkey:advance} at about the suggested time. Never switch weapon inside a window, only between. s skips a phase.

note_at_end: The button for every fire mode you switched (bounce, rocket, alternative, spin, thermal, secondary fire).
Ammo behaviour: which weapons ran out, which reloaded by themselves (the rocket launcher does) and which had no reload.
Which weapons you could NOT find in the weapon list, and the names you searched.
If the game stopped: copy the 'unimplemented instruction at ...' line it prints.
stop: At every prompt: s skips a phase, q finishes the session. A phase in progress is lost when you finish.

stop.text: Close the game window only after the last phase (or q). Hotkeys: continue with {hotkey:advance}.
Close the game window only after the last phase (or q).

send_back: Tell Claude the session finished: folder tmp/owner-profiles/mm-var-all (the analysis tables are printed at the end).
Which phases you skipped and why, and the buttons for the fire modes.
The 'unimplemented instruction' line if the game stopped.

1.title: Grenades and mines
1.weapons: Grenade, Plasma Grenade, Remote Mine (it comes with the remote in the other hand), Proximity Mine, Timed Mine

items.label: grenade_frag
items.name: Grenade
items.do: Throw grenades only (RT), wait until each one explodes, repeat. Do not move far or switch weapon.

items.label: grenade_plasma
items.name: Plasma Grenade
items.do: Throw plasma grenades only (RT), wait until each one goes off, repeat. Do not move far or switch weapon.

items.label: mine_remote
items.name: Remote Mine
items.do: Place a few remote mines (primary fire, RT), then trigger them with the remote in your other hand (SECONDARY fire), repeat. The detonator is the secondary fire of the remote mine, not a separate weapon.

items.label: mine_proximity
items.name: Proximity Mine
items.do: Place a mine, then walk away from it or let it trigger, repeat. Do not switch weapon.

items.label: mine_timed
items.name: Timed Mine
items.do: Place a mine and wait for it to go off, repeat. Do not switch weapon.

steps_after: The Map Maker offers only three mines (proximity, remote, timed): the remote mine and its remote take ONE weapon slot, so the five weapons fit the six slots.
steps: Idle control FIRST (phase ingame-idle:b{item}, except the FIRST batch of this run which uses plain ingame-idle): stand still, press nothing, do not pick anything up. It stops by itself after 20 s.

2.title: Sci-Fi Handgun, Sci-Fi Sniper Rifle, ElectroTool (normal and alternative fire modes)
2.weapons: Sci-Fi Handgun, Sci-Fi Handgun x2 (dual), Sci-Fi Sniper Rifle, ElectroTool, ElectroTool x2 (dual)

items.label: scifi_handgun_normal
items.name: Sci-Fi Handgun
items.do: Fire the Sci-Fi Handgun in its NORMAL mode only (hold or tap RT). Do not switch the fire mode, do not move or reload.

items.label: scifi_handgun_bounce
items.name: Sci-Fi Handgun
items.do: Switch the Sci-Fi Handgun to its BOUNCE mode first (shots ricochet off walls), then fire in bounce mode only. The docs do not name the mode button: try the other fire button, LT and the face buttons, and write down which one it was.

items.label: scifi_handgun_x2_normal
items.name: Sci-Fi Handgun x2
items.do: Fire the dual Sci-Fi Handguns in their NORMAL mode only (hold or tap RT, both guns). Do not switch the fire mode.

items.label: scifi_handgun_x2_bounce
items.name: Sci-Fi Handgun x2
items.do: Switch the dual Sci-Fi Handguns to BOUNCE mode first, then fire in bounce mode only. The docs do not name the mode button: try the other fire button, LT and the face buttons, and write down which one it was.

items.label: scifi_sniper_normal
items.name: Sci-Fi Sniper Rifle
items.do: Fire the Sci-Fi Sniper Rifle in its NORMAL mode only (RT), without the scope. Do not move or reload.

items.label: scifi_sniper_alt
items.name: Sci-Fi Sniper Rifle
items.do: Switch to the ALTERNATIVE mode first (the zoom scope, INFERRED from an earlier measurement), then fire in that mode only. The docs do not name the mode button: try the other fire button, LT and the face buttons, and write down which one it was.

items.label: electrotool_normal
items.name: ElectroTool
items.do: Fire the ElectroTool in its NORMAL mode only (hold RT). Do not switch the fire mode, do not move.

items.label: electrotool_alt
items.name: ElectroTool
items.do: Switch the ElectroTool to its ALTERNATIVE mode first, then fire in that mode only. The docs do not name the mode button: try the other fire button, LT and the face buttons, and write down which one it was.

items.label: electrotool_x2
items.name: ElectroTool x2
items.do: Fire the dual ElectroTools in their NORMAL mode only (hold RT, both). Do not switch the fire mode.

steps_after: Slots: Sci-Fi Handgun, its x2, the sniper, ElectroTool and its x2 are 5 weapons, one slot each. The mode phases use the SAME weapon: switch the mode, do not add a slot.
steps: Idle control FIRST (phase ingame-idle:b{item}, except the FIRST batch of this run which uses plain ingame-idle): stand still, press nothing, do not pick anything up. It stops by itself after 20 s.

8.title: Minigun (spin-up, overheating, constant spin)
8.weapons: Minigun (ONE weapon, there is NO Minigun x2)

items.label: minigun
items.name: Minigun
items.do: From rest (barrel not spinning) HOLD fire (RT) for about 5 s so the spin-up DELAY before the first shot is inside the phase, release, wait 3 s, repeat once. Normal mode.

items.label: minigun_overheat
items.name: Minigun
items.do: SUSTAINED fire: hold the trigger without releasing until the gun OVERHEATS (fire stops or the heat gauge is full), keep holding 3 s more, then release and wait for it to COOL DOWN fully (about 10 s) before you end the phase.

items.label: minigun_spin
items.name: Minigun
items.do: Switch to the CONSTANT SPIN alternative mode first (the barrel keeps spinning, ready to fire), let the barrel spin 5 s WITHOUT firing, then fire in short bursts of 1 to 2 s with pauses, no overheating. The docs do not name the mode button: try the other fire button, LT and the face buttons, and write down which one it was.

steps_after: The minigun has NO reload, so there is no reload phase (docs/t1527-minigun-census-and-callback.md).
steps: Idle control FIRST (phase ingame-idle:b{item}, except the FIRST batch of this run which uses plain ingame-idle): stand still, press nothing, do not pick anything up. It stops by itself after 20 s.
